name: sublingual
description: Monorepo: Electron desktop app, backend (Python), and shared packages

scripts.setup: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const command = isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash'; const args = isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', './install-dev.ps1'] : ['./install-dev.sh']; const result = spawnSync(command, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.backend: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { existsSync } = require('node:fs'); const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' : 'backend/.venv/bin/python'; const cmd = existsSync(py) ? py : 'python'; const result = spawnSync(cmd, ['backend/main.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.backend:uvicorn: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { existsSync } = require('node:fs'); const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' : 'backend/.venv/bin/python'; const cmd = existsSync(py) ? py : 'python'; const host = process.env.BACKEND_HOST || '127.0.0.1'; const port = process.env.BACKEND_PORT || '8765'; const result = spawnSync(cmd, ['-m', 'uvicorn', '--app-dir', 'backend', 'main:app', '--host', host, '--port', port], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
